# Control sweep (24h): every checkbox and spinner of the Options, Audio, Advanced and Realism pages clicked once
# Generated by scripts/gen-controls-tours.py from tour_options_24h.txt. CHANGES SETTINGS in the running game (the profile is written on exit):
# run only through scripts/gtr2-control-check.py, which launches the game for this tour alone, compares the profile and reverts it.
# Needs:  gtr2-nav.py path --setting-step FILE
# Format: PAGE | LABEL | EXPECTED PAGE   ('!CONTROLS' clicks every control of the page shown)
MAIN MENU | APP_BUTTON_ENDURANCE_EVENT | SUMMARY_ENDURANCE
SUMMARY_ENDURANCE | OPTIONS | OPTIONS_BASIC_24H
OPTIONS_BASIC_24H | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_BASIC_24H
OPTIONS_BASIC_24H | VIDEO | OPTIONS_DETAIL_24H
OPTIONS_DETAIL_24H | AUDIO | OPTIONS_AUDIO_24H
OPTIONS_AUDIO_24H | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_AUDIO_24H
OPTIONS_AUDIO_24H | ADVANCED | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_24H
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_24H | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_24H
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_24H | REALISM | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_24H
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_24H | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_24H
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_24H | CONTROLS | CONTROL_KEYS_24H
CONTROL_KEYS_24H | ADVANCED | CONTROL_ONE_24H
CONTROL_ONE_24H | FORCE | CONTROL_FORCE_24H
CONTROL_FORCE_24H | BACK | MAIN MENU
